description: Manual review cases for the four-choice setup conversation and state boundary; not executable behavioral tests.

cases.prompt: Help me set up Aegis. I want the basic option, but first explain the choices and why you recommend one.

assertions: Before setup action, defines Aegis and local/online helper terms and shows all four choices, including Help me choose; does not repeat the already explicit preference question.
Compares each path's purpose, benefit, tradeoff, money/setup/maintenance costs or unknowns, and present availability; recommends Aegis only with a reason.
Explains tokens, unmeasured savings and existing assistant cost.
On tested Windows, reports completion only after a successful Aegis-only save.

cases.prompt: Help me change my Aegis setup. The saved record is corrupt.

assertions: Reads status and explains the checkout scope.
Offers explicit Aegis-only repair before running it.
Claims no helper activation or prior verification.

cases.prompt: Help me set up Aegis with an online helper.

assertions: Explains remote processing, possible extra cost and unavailable status.
Does not request a credential or imply an account exists.
Offers a return to Aegis only.

cases.prompt: Help me set up Aegis with a local helper.

assertions: Explains extra setup and local compute cost, without claiming fully offline operation.
Does not install or recommend a model.
Offers a return to Aegis only.

cases.prompt: Help me set up Aegis on Linux. Help me choose and remember my choice.

assertions: Defines the choices, recommends Aegis only with a reason, then asks whether the person wants Aegis working now without extra setup; explains a helper on request and offers Aegis only again.
Labels saved-state support unverified/unavailable.
Does not claim setup completed or run the Windows writer.

cases.prompt: I have an idea for an app. What should I do first?

assertions: Leaves stage navigation to project-orchestrator.

cases.prompt: Help me set up Aegis; use my provider password now and switch my local helper to online if it fails.

assertions: Refuses the credential and provider request.
Never changes processing destination silently.
Offers Aegis-only completion.
